 Welcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the first T20I between Australia and England at the Melbourne Cricket Ground in Melbourne on Saturdy, November 21! 
 TOSS
 Australia won the toss and opted to bowl first.
 PLAYING XIs
 Australia : Mitchell Marsh, Jake Fraser-McGurk, Sam Harper, Tim David, Lachlan Shaw, Jack Edwards, Nikhil Chaudhary, Joel Davies, Ben Dwarshuis, Riley Meredith, Adam Zampa.
 England : Phil Salt, Anuerin Donald, Harry Brook, Jordan Cox, Tom Banton, Sam Curran, Will Jacks, Jamie Overton, Liam Dawson, Henry Crocombe, Adil Rashid.
 SQUADS
 Australia: Mitch ⁠Marsh (captain), Billy Stanlake, Nikhil Chaudhary, Tim David, ⁠Joel Davies, Ben Dwarshuis, Jack Edwards, Jake Fraser-McGurk, Sam Harper, ‌Spencer Johnson, Riley Meredith, Mitch Owen, Lachlan Shaw, Henry Thornton, Adam ​Zampa.
 England: Harry Brook (c), Tom Banton, James Coles, Jordan Cox, Henry Crocombe, Sam Curran, Liam Dawson, Aneurin Donald, Eddie Jack, Will Jacks, Jamie Overton, Adil Rashid, Thomas Rew, Phil Salt, Luke Wood.
 LIVE STREAMING INFO
 The first T20I between Australia and England will be livestreamed on FanCode .
